title: South Florida Halloween plans you can actually verify
igCaption:
Halloween plans across South Florida, with the details that are actually listed 🎃
Oct. 31, South Florida, free to $35 listed

Sources: Miami New Times, Facebook, South Florida Reporter, The Palm Beach Post

#MiamiEvents #FortLauderdaleEvents #WestPalmBeach #HalloweenMiami

scenes.text: Halloween plans in South Florida have a few clear listings.
In Miami, Deli Lane and Sunset Tavern in South Miami lists a Halloween party at 10 a.m. on October 31. Admission is free, and there is a costume contest.
scenes.caption: In Miami, Deli Lane and Sunset Tavern in South Miami lists a Halloween party at 10 a.m. on Oct. 31. Admission is free, and there is a costume contest.

scenes.text: In Fort Lauderdale, Flagler Village is set for the 3rd Annual Flagler Village Halloween Bar Crawl on October 31. Five local hotspots are taking part.
scenes.caption: In Fort Lauderdale, Flagler Village is set for the 3rd Annual Flagler Village Halloween Bar Crawl on Oct. 31. Five local hotspots are taking part.

scenes.text: For West Palm Beach, the local event pages point to Halloween weekend activity, but they do not list crawl details. Daylight saving time ends today in Florida, and clocks fall back tonight. If you end up at a West Palm crawl, NEAR shows who was there too.

scenes.text: Halloween brings showers and storms into the early evening on the mainland. A high risk of dangerous rip currents stays in place at Atlantic beaches through Sunday evening.
